title: Vorschau: Armin Mueller-Stahl - Ein Gaukler in Hollywood • Deutschland 2020
description: ARTE am 06.09.2026: Ob als 007 der DDR in der erfolgreichen Serie „Das unsichtbare Visier“, als in New York gestrandeter ostdeutscher Taxifahrer in „Night on Earth“ oder als NS-Verbrecher in der Hollywoodproduktion „Musicbox“. Mit fast 140 Filmen hat Armin Mueller-Stahl Filmgeschichte geschrieben und es als einer der wenigen Deutschen geschafft, sich als Hollywoodschauspieler zu etablieren. Mehrmals musste er wieder ganz von vorn anfangen: nach dem Zweiten Weltkrieg, den er als Kind erlebte, nach seinem Bruch mit der DDR-Führung und dem Neustart in der Bundesrepublik oder bei seinem Schritt nach Hollywood. Armin Mueller-Stahl hat sich für das Risiko des möglichen Scheiterns entschieden. Schon als Kind in Ostpreußen wächst er mit Musik und Malerei auf, beginnt als junger Mann zunächst in Westberlin Violine zu studieren. Wendet sich aber der Schauspielkunst zu und wird zu einem der bekanntesten Theater- und Filmschauspieler der DDR. Nach seiner Übersiedlung etabliert er sich auch in der Bundesrepublik, unter anderem durch die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Regisseur Rainer Werner Fassbinder. Und dann Hollywood: Nach knapp 70 Jahren erwirkt er mit dem Film „Shine“ erstmals wieder eine Oscarnominierung für einen deutschen Schauspieler. ARTE geht gemeinsam mit Armin Mueller-Stahl auf Spurensuche in seinem bewegten Leben zwischen Ost- und Westdeutschland und Hollywood. Und zeigt ihn noch einmal in seinen besten Rollen, als Sänger und Musiker, als Maler in seinem Atelier an der Ostsee und vor allem als Mensch.

If you choose to stay in the group, you and the blocked person will be able to see each other’s messages in the group. They won’t be able to find your profile or content on Threads. From your hidden replies, you can unhide a reply by tapping Options next to the reply and then tapping Unhide . Hidden replies in your threads are moved to a covered section at the bottom of your thread. Others can still view these replies. This setting is on by default, but you can change it any time. Click Toggle next to Hide common offensive words in replies to turn this setting on and cover words many people don’t want to see. text: Meta AI on Instagram: Unleash Creativity | About Instagram Discover, Create, and Connect with Meta AI on Instagram December 23, 2024 Get ready to let your curiosity lead you with Meta AI on Instagram. Designed to enhance your day-to-day life, Meta AI can help you learn, create, complete tasks, and discover things you’re curious about – all in an app where your friends are. Curious? Ask Meta AI Meta AI helps you get more out of your day by helping you make each moment a little more memorable. Dressing to impress? Ask for “outfits that aren’t trying too hard” to make sure you look good while staying true to yourself. Or, for a night in with your friends, find videos for easy but delicious five-ingredient recipes that you can whip up in no time. You can now talk to Meta AI and it’ll respond back to you out loud. Get answers to those questions you’re curious about or listen to a joke to lighten the mood. Use your voice to talk to AI on Instagram by tapping to ask a question like “what are the top things to do in New York City?” or a silly request like “imagine a cat wearing an astronaut suit on Mars.” Meta AI will provide a voice response or share media to answer your request, however silly or realistic. You can also choose from different voice options for your assistant – including some familiar ones like the AI voices of Awkwafina, Dame Judi Dench, John Cena, Keegan Michael Key and Kristen Bell. Enhance Your Words with Meta AI We’ve all been there. When you want to say something but don’t know exactly how to phrase it. Maybe a friend commented on your Story and you want to respond with something clever. Maybe you are trying to figure out what to write in a surprise party invite to a group chat with friends. With Meta AI, you can find the right words to navigate any conversation. Ask Meta AI for advice or tag Meta AI in any private or group chat and ask it to chime in. Unleash your Inner Creative Meta AI is not just a chatbot; it’s a gateway into your imagination. Ever daydream about being a renowned popstar singing at a music festival or revered royalty in the ancient times? Imagine yourself with Meta AI, and see yourself in an entirely new setting. How to imagine yourself in DMs: Access the search bar in DMs and the Meta AI icon will appear or @Meta AI in a chat thread. Type “Imagine me as…” (ex; type “vampire” or “gladiator”). If it’s your first time using this feature, you’ll be asked to add photos of yourself. Meta AI will generate the images in the thread for friends to see. When you share in Stories, others can click on a sticker that gets automatically added, so they can try it out for themselves. Easily share Imagine images to your friends through your Story by clicking the “+” icon in Story and find the “AI images” on the top of your screen. You can choose either one of the suggested prompts, or create your own! There’s More With AI on DMs Need help editing your photos? Send an image in a chat with Meta AI and tell Meta AI what you want added, removed or changed in the photo – from changing your outfit to putting a goat on a surfboard. In your photos shared with Meta AI, Meta AI can understand what it’s looking at and help answer questions about it. You can make the perfect personalized theme for your 1:1 and group chats using AI. Just tap Themes in your chat details to get started. To learn more on how to edit images with Meta AI, visit the Help Center . To learn how to create themes with Meta AI, visit the Help Center for more. Meta AI on Instagram offers a world of possibilities for learning, creating, and connecting you to the things that matter to you. Explore new subjects, receive tips in social interactions, and even uncover a new side of you that nobody has ever seen before.
